meta.description: Narrative-driven first-person puzzle/simulation set in a mysterious laboratory, created for the Floodlight Gaming Investigative Journalism Game Jam.

content.title: Under Inspection
about: You wake to the sound of a ringing phone. It’s not yours. This isn’t your home. A voice gives you a simple order: package goods, don’t complain.
Beyond the bedroom door lies a sterile, fluorescent-lit laboratory. Each day, the work grows more demanding and every task carries higher stakes — don’t mess up.
Created as a team submission for the Floodlight Gaming: Investigative Journalism Game Jam.
features: First-person immersive gameplay in a mysterious laboratory
Task-driven "working simulator" loop with escalating pressure
Puzzle interactions (object handling, left/right click mechanics)
Narrative progression through new lab areas and decisions
learnings: Designing short, readable gameplay tasks with escalating constraints
Rapid iteration and scope control under a fixed deadline
Coordinating a multi-discipline team with clear handoffs and integration
